extDescription.message: Injects the X-OeHub-Oid header into requests to configured domains.

popupIntro.message: Automatically adds an X-OeHub-Oid header to requests sent to the domains registered below, so oeProxy can identify your per-user routing information. When disabled, oeProxy identifies routing information using the IP address instead.

domainsHelp.message: One domain per line. Wildcard prefix (*.) is supported.
